note: Launches the Academy’s primer “Mathematics in the age of artificial intelligence”: AI is fundamentally mathematical, mathematics underpins both AI capability and trustworthiness, and sustained UK investment in the mathematical sciences is essential. Case studies: Wayve, Quantexa and Isomorphic Labs. Quotes Oxford’s Ben Walker: he is more excited about what mathematics can do for AI than the reverse.
title: Maths in the Age of AI: why the mathematical sciences matter more than ever
